notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature that has indestructible.
You control at least one additional creature that has haste and/or flash.
easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional artifact.
You do not control a creature that has flying.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Odric triggers, giving creatures you control indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Shaman by sacrificing an artifact, dealing 1 damage to each creature without flying.
Sonic's second ability triggers for each creature you control with haste or flash that was dealt damage, creating that many tapped Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 2.
